name: The Soldier's Pocket Note
description: A handwritten note from the quarantined town.
readingText:
If anyone finds this, tell my brother I didn't run.

We were ordered to hold the western road until morning. At two o'clock, the radio stopped working. At three, the lieutenant ordered us to turn off our lights.

We could hear something moving between the buildings.

It passed our position twice without attacking.

Then someone behind us began calling out the names of our men.

The lieutenant knew not to answer.

I wish he had told us why.
